query: Which drama series won the most recent Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series?

results.title: Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series
results.content:
Since 2000, every single winner has been a serial drama "Serial (radio and television)"): _The West Wing_ (2000–2003), _The Sopranos_ (2004, 2007), _Lost "Lost (2004 TV series)")_ (2005), _24 "24 (TV series)")_ (2006), _Mad Men_ (2008–2011), _Homeland "Homeland (TV series)")_ (2012), _Breaking Bad_ (2013–2014), _Game of Thrones_ (2015–2016, 2018–2019), _The Handmaid's Tale "The Handmaid's Tale (TV series)")_ (2017), _Succession "Succession (TV series)")_ (2020, 2022-2023), _The Crown "The Crown (TV series)")_ (2021), _Shōgun "Shōgun (2024 TV series)")_ (2024) and _The Pitt "The Pitt (TV series)")_ (2025). Since the advent of _Hill Street Blues_ in 1981, every winner has had some serialized arcs with the exception of _Law & Order_.( The majority of these shows have won between their first and fifth seasons. Only one show have been exceeded with more than sixth seasons onwards who have won multiple times is _Game of Thrones_ with sixth, seventh, and eighth; the remaining shows within more than sixth seasons who also won one are _The Sopranos_ with sixth and _Law & Order_ with seventh.Since 1967, they are the only non-US series or television series from outside the United States to be nominated including _The Avengers "The Avengers (TV series)")_, _The Forsyte Saga "The Forsyte Saga (1967 TV series)")_, _The First Churchills_, _Elizabeth R_, _The Six Wives of Henry VIII "The Six Wives of Henry VIII (BBC TV series)")_, _Upstairs, Downstairs_ "Upstairs, Downstairs (1971 TV series)"), _Rumpole of the Bailey_, _Downton Abbey_, _Bodyguard_ "Bodyguard (British TV series)"), _Killing Eve,_ _Squid Game_, and _Slow Horses_; most non-US series are entirely United Kingdom, _Squid Game_ is the only Asia and South Korea to do so. _Elizabeth R_ and _Upstairs, Downstairs_ are the only two to win, while the latter is the only one to win multiple times.

_Game of Thrones_, _Hill Street Blues_, _L.A. Law_, _Mad Men_, and _The West Wing_ share the record for most wins in the category with four. _Law & Order_ holds the record for most nominations in the category with eleven, while _Better Call Saul_ holds the record for most nominations without a win with seven.

Since 2022, _Squid Game_ (Korean) and _Shōgun "Shōgun (2024 TV series)")_ (Japanese) are the only non-English language series to be nominated in that category; _Shōgun_ being the first to win.

Since 2023, _The Last of Us "The Last of Us (TV series)")_ and _Fallout "Fallout (American TV series)")_ are the only series based on their respective video games to be nominated in that category.
